::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/decline_rules"}
#docs
A code we recognise that no rule names is returned with `overridable: false` — omitting it would suggest we do not handle a decline we handle correctly.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gateway` | `string` | no | Only the rules for this gateway. |
| `overridden` | `string` | no | Only rows this business has changed. |
| `gateway_account` | `string` | no | Resolve overrides for ONE gateway account. An account-scoped setting beats the business-wide one. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `decline_rule`. One of `decline_rule`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | e.g. stripe.code.expired_card |
| `data.overridable` | `boolean` | False for a code we recognise that no RULE names. Its answer is still real and a code-level override still governs it; there is simply no rule id to aim a rule-level PATCH at, and one aimed there answers 404. |
| `data.gateway` | `string` | The gateway this rule applies to. One of `stripe`, `paypal`, `razorpay`, `gocardless`, `braintree`, `cashfree`, `authorizenet`, `adyen`, `checkoutcom`, `mollie`, `square`, `payu`, `cybersource`. |
| `data.matches` | `object` | The predicate that selects this rule. First match wins. |
| `data.code` | `string` | Our canonical code, e.g. expired_card |
| `data.error_id` | `string` | The canonical code on the namespaced axis: gateway.&lt;family&gt;.&lt;code&gt;, using Eleven families, so an imported book aggregates with ours. |
| `data.family` | `string` | The rule's decline family. |
| `data.built_in` | `object` | The rule's built-in behavior. |
| `data.override` | `object` | Null until this business changes something. |
| `data.effective` | `object` | What collection will actually do. |
| `orphaned_overrides` | `array of object` | Settings whose target a deploy removed. Surfaced rather than hidden: a merchant whose preference silently stopped applying has no other way to discover it. |
| `code_overrides` | `array of object` | Settings made on a canonical CODE. Listed separately because one can be invisible in `data`: when every rule under it also has its own row, the narrower rows win. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such business, or no such gateway account |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/decline_rules" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
